02 / THE BRIEF

Teach lessTell more

The client commissioned the film as a proof of capability: could AI transform an ambitious educational advertising idea into a coherent screen story with a leaner demand for time, cost and production resources?

The answer could not rely on technology alone. The film needed a narrative people would willingly follow: MoMo's mascot opens a time portal, guides the audience from barter and early currency to paper money and digital payments, then lets the brand arrive as the natural final chapter—not an interruption.

03 / CREATIVE DIRECTION

A brand inside
the adventure

01 / DEVICE

Time travel with purpose

The portal is not decoration. It gives every historical era a clear entrance, a visual transition and a reason for the mascot to keep moving.

02 / CLARITY

Evidence you can see

Barter, shells, coins, paper and digital payment become concrete scenes, so information is understood through action rather than explained as a lecture.

03 / BRAND

Integration, not interruption

MoMo enters from the first frame as the guide. By the digital era, the product feels like the destination of the story—not a sales message attached at the end.

05 / OUTCOME
AI made the world producible. Story made it worth entering

The finished film demonstrated that a broad historical journey, a consistent mascot and branded digital-payment moments could be realised through a substantially leaner production model. But the decisive value remained human: narrative structure, visual judgement and an understanding of audience psychology made the brand feel welcome. AI translated that thinking into a finished film—it did not replace it.
